items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: whom I had the pleasure of working with for about three years. And we have Chink Martin, the old Chink Martin that is... Chink Martin Sr.

ctx.x: I see a photograph here of Johnny Wig's band that you took yourself. You like to take photographs?

Well, every... Once in a while? I don't get out to the Jazz Festival every year, but I try to get out when I can get out there. And when I do, I usually bring my camera. And as you know, at the Jazz Festival, which is held every year out at the fairgrounds here in New Orleans, there's about eight or ten different stages. And there's bands that are swapping around about every hour on all the various stages. And you get quite a variety of music, you've got Dixieland jazz and country and western and what have you.…
Did you ever play the festival? No, I never did.
